build-fm.title: Build an FM transmitter
build-fm.prompt: Put the five stages in order from microphone to antenna.

blocks.label: Speech amplifier
blocks.does: makes the weak microphone audio stronger

blocks.label: Modulator
blocks.does: varies the oscillator's frequency in step with the audio

blocks.label: Frequency multiplier
blocks.does: picks a harmonic to reach the operating frequency

blocks.label: Power amplifier
blocks.does: raises the signal to full power

slots.out: a control signal that follows the audio
RF whose frequency swings with your voice
a harmonic: the FM carrier at the operating frequency

hints: The modulator works on the oscillator, so it comes just before it.
build-fm.success: Speech amp, modulator, oscillator, multiplier, power amp. The modulator swings the oscillator's frequency; the multiplier lifts it to the operating frequency.

find-power.title: The power-hungry stage
find-power.prompt: Which stage draws the most power from the supply?

blocks.label: Power amplifier
blocks.does: raises the signal to tens of watts

find-power.success: The power amplifier: it makes the full output power, so it draws the most from the supply.
